title: Speed of Thought
tagline: Your fastest input is your voice. Your fastest output is a tap.
body1: A 30-minute meeting produces ten decisions. Then someone spends 45 minutes typing those decisions into a project management tool. The brain operates at the speed of thought. Software operates at the speed of typing. That mismatch costs hours every day.
body2: Consider an email reply. Reading three AI-generated variants: 10 seconds. Tapping send on the right one: 0.1 seconds. Total: 10.1 seconds. Writing from scratch: 3–5 minutes. That's 20x faster. Over 20 emails a day, it's the difference between an hour and four minutes.
quote: "We didn't speed up typing. We eliminated the need for it."
